name: ImgCompress
description: Self-hosted image compression, conversion, resizing, AI upscaling, and background removal web app supporting over 70 image formats with local processing inside an unprivileged container.
short_desc: Self-hosted image compressor, converter, AI upscaler, and background remover
author: karimz1

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name. Default: imgcompress (if left blank, falls back to imgcompress).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').

form_fields.label: MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB
form_fields.hint: Maximum upload size limit in megabytes. Leave blank to keep the upstream default (40960).

form_fields.label: WEB_WORKERS
form_fields.hint: Web worker concurrency ('auto' or a positive integer). Leave blank to use the upstream default (auto).
form_fields.pattern_error: Enter 'auto' or a positive integer (1 or greater).

form_fields.label: DISABLE_LOGO
form_fields.hint: Hide the sidebar mascot in the web interface (true or false). Leave blank to keep the upstream default (false).

form_fields.label: DISABLE_STORAGE_MANAGEMENT
form_fields.hint: Disable automatic temporary storage cleanup management (true or false). Leave blank to keep the upstream default (false).

form_fields.label: DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK
form_fields.hint: Disable outbound update checks against GitHub releases (true or false). Leave blank to keep the upstream default (false).

form_fields.label: NOTIFY_URL
form_fields.hint: Optional Apprise notification URL for batch completion alerts. Leave blank to disable notifications.

form_fields.label: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
form_fields.hint: Optional public HTTP or HTTPS base URL included in notification links (without embedded credentials).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a valid http:// or https:// URL without spaces or embedded credentials.
